prompts.text: Which family story sounds different now you have heard another person's version?
What would you like us to understand about the role you were given when you were young?
Tell us about a relative you understood better after becoming an adult.
Which kind of help from family leaves you feeling more capable afterwards?
Families remember some achievements loudly and others quietly. Which quiet achievement deserves attention?
When have we mistaken your independence for having no need of us?

What do you wish we asked about your everyday life instead of your next milestone?
Which expression of affection in our family took you time to recognise?
Revisit a family misunderstanding together or hear a memory we have never shared?
Who helped you feel part of this family before you knew how to explain that feeling?
What should being the oldest, youngest or only child never oblige someone to do?
Describe a family member being brave in a way nobody celebrated at the time.
What have you chosen to carry forward from our family, and what have you adapted?
When does family advice begin to feel like a vote on your life?

Which family nickname have you outgrown, even if it once suited you?

Which shared object carries a different meaning for each of us?
